integration_issues.flow: Chat page reload after merchant-chat auto-open
integration_issues.issue: React Router's location.state (set by Marketplace.chatSeller via navigate('/app/chat', { state: { open: ... } })) is backed by window.history.state, so if the user hits browser-reload while on /app/chat after being auto-navigated, Chat.jsx re-reads location.state.open and reopens the same conversation. In-app navigation (bottom-nav or fresh URL) is unaffected. Suggested fix: after consuming location.state.open in Chat.jsx, clear it via navigate('.', { replace: true, state: null }) or window.history.replaceState({}, '').
